note: Predictions frozen BEFORE any S9 model call. S9 is a controlled wording experiment: original S5 method vs candidate capability-aware variant, both WITH the measurement, on frozen fleets A (primary) and D (safety mirror). N=8 replicates per cell, interleaved. The candidate is a runtime transform of the frozen S5 seed (only methods[1].statement changed); S5 is not modified. The hypothesis: the S8 A composition miss is a method-wording problem, not a measurement problem. Fleet hashes are the S7/S8 frozen hashes (asserted at run time).
original_method_2_statement: Count how many workers depend on each shared component; when one component dominates, flag it as a blast-radius risk.
candidate_method_2_statement: Read how many workers depend on each shared component from the `dependency_concentration` measurement in the snapshot (its counts and shares are mechanically computed from fleet records); use those facts directly and do not re-derive them. Compute by hand only what no measurement resolves, and when one component dominates, flag it as a blast-radius risk.
candidate_transform_note: Deep-copy the 3 frozen S5 methods; keep methods[0] and methods[2] and all knowledge/preferences byte-identical; replace only methods[1].statement with the candidate text. No other field changes.

A-orig.basis: S8 METHOD+MEASUREMENT/A (single run): 2 calls, 0 NameErrors, re-derived both calls, cites_measurement=False, identified 60/70 (85.7%), interpretation LLM.
A-orig.rederivation_calls_per_run: ~2 (the frozen 'count it yourself' instruction drives re-derivation)
A-orig.cites_measurement_rate: low (the S8 single run was False; expect mostly False across N=8)
A-orig.categorical_outcome: mostly 'rederive' / 'rederive+cite' at best; 'read' rare or never
A-orig.predicted_miss: the wording still drives re-derivation; the measurement is bypassed where the concentration is real

A-cand.basis: NEW. The one-field wording treatment: method 2 now says read the measurement, do not re-derive, compute only what remains unresolved.
A-cand.rederivation_calls_per_run: ~0-1 (drops vs A-orig; the instruction now defers to the measurement)
A-cand.cites_measurement_rate: high (most runs cite/lean on the measurement)
A-cand.categorical_outcome: mostly 'read' (rederivation==0, cites measurement, identifies 60/70 correctly from the OBSERVED facts)
A-cand.predicted_win: re-derivation reduced; OBSERVED measurement facts used correctly; complementary computation retained; interpretation with LLM -- the S8 A miss fixed by wording, not by changing the measurement

D-orig.basis: S8 METHOD+MEASUREMENT/D (single run): 1 call, 0 NameErrors, cites_measurement=True (the only S8 cell that did), no false concentration, found reservation cohort 17/70.
D-orig.categorical_outcome: mostly 'read' (already composes on D in S8)

D-cand.basis: safety mirror. The candidate must not regress the S8 D win.
D-cand.categorical_outcome: matches or improves on D-orig; 'read' dominant
D-cand.safety_note: D-cand failing here (e.g. re-deriving more, or inventing a false concentration because the candidate wording mentions the measurement by name) would be a real preserved finding -- the wording that helps A hurts D.

hypothesis: The S8 A composition miss is a method-wording problem, not a measurement problem. A capability-aware method that preserves the supervisory question but defers factual computation to the mechanically grounded measurement composes on A (where the frozen 'count it yourself' method did not), without regressing the D win and without removing interpretation from the LLM.
success_criteria: 1. reduction in concentration_rederivation: A-cand < A-orig across the N=8 distribution
2. correct use of OBSERVED measurement facts: A-cand 'read' outcome dominant; uses the measurement's actual counts/shares, not just name-drops
3. complementary rather than duplicate computation: A-cand keeps complementary calls (reservation exception, digest split) while re-derivation drops
4. interpretation remains with the LLM: claims_measurement_says_risk=False; interpretation_with_llm=True; measurement/contract report facts only
5. safety mirror: D-cand does not regress D-orig (still reads, no false concentration, few calls)
6. floor frozen: concentration.py unchanged; s7/memory_seed unchanged (S5 not edited); snapshot.py/rulebook.jsonl unchanged; authority bounded
